I wanted to make a place to escape sugar. I've never thought about it for 28 years. I've had the odd sugar crash, I'm not diabetic and I'm in the green on my BMI; but recently I've realized how much of a hook sugar has on my life. Through reading I've found you don't actually need it, it's not a necessary item in our diets. In fact since having removed it from my diet I've never felt better.

It's addictive, makes you want more, makes everything else taste bitter (I'll get to this) and a major cause of obesity.

So I gave it up, or tried. I started trying to only buy food with less than 3g of sugar per 100g. That's hard. You suddenly find there is very little you can buy. (Edit: Not just hard to find stuff but healthy food is expensive. You will notice you spend more to eat better)

So what is nosugar? It's a place to share low sugar diets, your sugar experiences, recipes, stories, memes and anything related to the demise of sugar from your life. We're not going to remove sugar from our lives but by reducing it makes everything get sweeter.
